paths.description: Mandatory age gate and cookie choice, followed by the underlying homepage/feed. Represents the global entry boundary and primary browse surface.
Video listing template reached at /video; it redirects through the same gate and represents content indexes.
Representative video detail URL discovered from homepage links; used for content metadata and crawlability.
Login modal opened after clearing the age gate; fields, autocomplete, providers, and empty-submit recovery were inspected.
Invalid route used to inspect HTTP/navigation recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Theme is fixed rather than preference-driven
findings.evidence: Light and dark emulation produced byte-identical 99,208-byte screenshots; the DOM/CSS probe found no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark() usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surface tokens through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not handled
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, so custom orange, grey, and black controls have no explicit high-contrast adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast rules that preserve text, focus, borders, and control affordances.

findings.summary: State changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: The age-gate interaction video shows the modal disappearing into the content grid without a directional or continuity transition; CSS contains no authored view-transition rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a same-document View Transition for the gate-to-content state and retain an instant fallback for reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long-feed navigation is not scroll-state aware
findings.evidence: The post-gate screenshot shows a long card feed with static navigation, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state container query or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a compact sticky header or progress/return affordance driven by scroll-state or CSS scroll-linked state.

findings.summary: Menus do not use resilient anchor positioning
findings.evidence: The main navigation exposes multiple dropdown menus, but CSS inspection found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance dropdowns with CSS anchor positioning and fallback positions.

findings.summary: Navigation state changes provide little attention guidance
findings.evidence: The age-gate flow swaps directly to a dense grid and CSS contains no view-transition, highlight, or scroll-marker styling to orient the user.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a short directional transition and move focus to the content heading after entry.

findings.summary: Overlays are custom div-based widgets
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found zero dialog, popover, or details elements even though the page uses an age gate, cookie controls, login modal, and dropdowns.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal flows and popover/details for transient/disclosure UI, with native focus and light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Ads and repeated controls crowd the content grid
findings.evidence: The post-gate first viewport contains two ad cards and repeated Remove Ads controls among content cards, plus a full-width cookie-choice nag at the bottom.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce repeated ad chrome, reserve fewer premium placements, and collapse repeated actions into one clearly labelled control.

findings.summary: The mobile age gate is visibly clipped
findings.evidence: At 360x800, the heading, explanatory copy, law-enforcement link, and under-18 button extend beyond the right edge even though the body reports zero horizontal overflow, making the clipped content unreachable.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed-width modal internals with max-inline-size:100%, fluid padding, wrapping button layout, and logical sizing.

findings.summary: Reusable UI relies on viewport styling only
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across homepage, listing, and detail templates found no @container or container-type rules despite cards and overlays appearing in several widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for card grids, navigation groups, and modal action rows.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch sizing are inconsistent
findings.evidence: The focus probe found no outline or box shadow on cookie buttons and search; many visible links are only 15-22px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast ring and provide at least 24x24 CSS px targets, preferably 44x44 for primary mobile controls.

findings.summary: The required age-confirmation flow breaks on mobile
findings.evidence: At 360px, the under-18 exit action and portions of the legal text are clipped off-screen, so the required entry/exit choice is not fully available.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the gate a single-column, fully reflowing flow and keep both Enter and Exit controls visible without horizontal clipping.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance misses the Core Web Vitals bar
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 8.8s, FCP 3.9s, TTI 9.7s, and CLS 0.095 (performance score 0.61); the trace independently measured LCP 3.17s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the age-gate LCP element, shrink the document and critical chain, and delay non-essential ads/analytics until after consent and entry.

findings.summary: Late content shifts the mobile layout
findings.evidence: The 360px layout observer recorded CLS 0.102 from a shift at about 4.83s; the desktop observer recorded 0.056.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for banners and late UI, and add explicit dimensions/aspect ratios to the three unsized images.

findings.summary: The entry experience has a heavy critical network path
findings.evidence: HAR captured 173 requests and 5.27MB transferred, including 11 stylesheets, 40 scripts, ten parser/high-priority render-blocking candidates, and a 1.9MB document response.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical gate CSS, defer non-essential scripts, consolidate styles, and avoid loading the full feed and ad stack behind the gate.

findings.summary: Substantial unused code ships before the core task
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 288KiB unused JavaScript and 74KiB unused CSS; three tag-manager bundles account for most unused JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Load analytics and feed bundles conditionally after consent/entry and split gate CSS/JS from the full application bundle.

findings.summary: Embedded ads and controls expose incorrect accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple visible ad iframes without titles and a User Icon button whose accessible name does not include its visible Log in label.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every meaningful iframe a concise title, mark decorative frames presentation-only, and align visible and accessible control names.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus treatment do not provide a reliable keyboard path
findings.evidence: The gate has no h1 and the DOM probe found no main/nav landmarks; several cookie and search controls focus with no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic main/nav landmarks, make the gate title an h1, and add persistent :focus-visible styling in logical tab order.

findings.summary: Mobile text is clipped and cannot reflow
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshot cuts multiple lines at the right edge, including the heading and legally important age text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid inline sizing, overflow-wrap, and responsive type/spacing so every line remains visible at 320-360px.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled on a served variant
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a viewport declaration with maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; the focus probe also found many sub-24px-high targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions and enlarge compact interactive targets.

findings.summary: The homepage throws an uncaught exception
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading addEventListener) in setInstallButton at homepage line 4546.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard the queried install element before attaching the listener and add an automated console-clean smoke test.

findings.summary: Image delivery is structurally incomplete
findings.evidence: The image audit found three images without width/height, 33 without srcset, and 17 legacy-format assets, although doctype and UTF-8 are valid.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions and responsive sources; emit AVIF/WebP where supported while retaining fallbacks.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported an unload listener, deprecated Cast-control CSS, two deprecation warnings, inspector cookie issues, and four BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload with pagehide/visibilitychange, use disableRemotePlayback, and remove avoidable no-store/unload BFCache blockers.

findings.summary: Public templates expose generic metadata
findings.evidence: Homepage, listing, detail, and login recon all rendered title Pornhub; no meta description was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit unique server-rendered titles and descriptions for each page archetype before the age gate runs.

findings.summary: Crawler and mobile signals are broken
findings.evidence: The homepage declares noindex,nofollow, 30 anchors have empty/javascript hrefs, Lighthouse found uncrawlable anchors, and /robots.txt returns the homepage HTML.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid robots.txt, use real href URLs, preserve the viewport without disabling zoom, and scope any necessary noindex narrowly.

findings.summary: Canonical, sitemap, and indexing policy are inconsistent
findings.evidence: The .org URL redirects to .com, the homepage canonical points to .com but also says noindex,nofollow, /robots.txt returns HTML, and /sitemap.xml returns 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose the canonical public host, remove accidental noindex, serve valid robots.txt and sitemaps, and make redirects/canonicals consistent.

findings.summary: Content/detail pages lack rich metadata
findings.evidence: The inspected video detail rendered no JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter, or hreflang metadata and retained the generic Pornhub title.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata that matches visible content, with safe preview policy.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but baseline defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP or X-Content-Type-Options; cookies evidence found the rp cookie not Secure and SameSite=None. HSTS is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a nonce/hash-based CSP and nosniff, and set Secure with an appropriate SameSite value on every HTTPS cookie.

findings.summary: Tracking and ad-tech load before the user enters
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 13 third-party origins including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick; HAR recorded 171 cross-origin requests and 5.27MB before age confirmation.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential analytics/ad requests until explicit consent and entry, reduce vendors, and batch essential telemetry.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced policies are absent
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; X-Frame-Options and HSTS are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP with frame-ancestors, nosniff, strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Core content and route identity degrade without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 30-35% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML; listing/login URLs collapse to the generic homepage/gate and core navigation depends on scripted controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render route-specific metadata and core links/content, and make legal entry/exit actions work as real form/link submissions.

findings.summary: Runtime behavior is fragile at the entry boundary
findings.evidence: The required modal clips content on mobile, /login collapses to the homepage gate before entry, and the homepage throws an uncaught listener exception.
findings.suggestedFix: Make overlay sizing intrinsic, preserve requested return URLs through the gate, and guard optional runtime elements.

findings.summary: Language support is not backed by bidi-resilient layout
findings.evidence: The page offers many languages and sets lang=en, but has no dir attribute, no logical CSS properties, and at least 16 physical left/right declarations in the inspected CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir explicitly per locale and replace physical spacing/positioning with inline/block logical properties.

findings.summary: Rejecting optional cookies triggers a nag to accept all
findings.evidence: After Accept Only Essential Cookies, a persistent banner says features may be unavailable and recommends Accept All Cookies, weakening the user’s choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Honor essential-only consent without repeated persuasion; explain only genuinely unavailable features at the point of use.

findings.summary: Empty sign-in submission gives no actionable feedback
findings.evidence: The login modal has email/password autocomplete tokens, but submitting empty fields produced no :invalid elements, no aria-invalid state, no live-region message, and no visible error text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required constraints, validate after interaction, focus the first invalid field, and announce concise errors in an aria-live region.

findings.summary: Image formats and responsive delivery waste bytes
findings.evidence: The image audit found 33 of 37 images without srcset and 17 legacy-format images; three images lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive srcset/sizes and AVIF/WebP variants, preserving explicit dimensions and lazy loading.

findings.summary: The gate loads the full feed, ads, and analytics in the background
findings.evidence: Before entry, HAR recorded 173 requests, 38 XHR/fetches, 78 images, and 5.27MB; underlying feed assets and analytics are loaded behind the blocking gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a minimal gate shell and defer feed, ad, preview, and analytics work until consent and successful entry.

findings.summary: Third-party cost dominates the initial budget
findings.evidence: HAR attributes virtually all transfer from the .org start URL to cross-origin hosts after redirect, including about 1.0MB from TrafficJunky and 468KB from Google Tag Manager.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party byte/request budget, lazy-load ads below the fold, and consolidate or remove redundant tag-manager payloads.

findings.summary: The blocked entry state has a disproportionate heap footprint
findings.evidence: A single age-gated load retained about 38.4MB self size across 587,659 heap nodes and 52,371 closures before the underlying feed was usable.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not instantiate the full feed/ad application behind the gate; lazy-initialize page modules after entry and consent.

Restore landmarks, names, iframe titles, focus, zoom, and targets
Replace custom modal/disclosure primitives with dialog/popover/details
Fix console errors, deprecated APIs, and BFCache blockers
Add preference-driven color and contrast support
Optimise responsive image formats and dimensions
Make sign-in validation humane and accessible
Honor essential-only consent without a persistent upsell
